title: CCZ4-inclusive principal-symbol composition
question: Does minimally coupled Nulloth retain a complete frozen characteristic basis when its physical symbol is composed with constrained CCZ4 gravitational, gauge, and constraint modes?
prediction: The 23-variable algebraically reduced CCZ4 block and 25-variable Nulloth physical block form a complete 48-variable principal basis; normalized production cross blocks decay with Fourier order and vanish in the principal limit; the physical sector remains causal while the registered Gamma-driver gauge speed remains below 1.2.
falsifier: An incomplete diagonal-block or composed eigenspace, a non-real characteristic frequency beyond tolerance, failure of cross-block decay, a physical speed above unity, or a composed spectrum differing from the union of its diagonal blocks falsifies the claim.
controls: CCZ4 conformal-metric and conformal-curvature perturbations are restricted to the tangent space of determinant one and zero trace, matching the production algebraic projection.
Configuration variables are rescaled by Fourier magnitude before the second-order CCZ4 symbol is normalized.
The CCZ4 diagonal block is linearized independently in vacuum so algebraic matter sources cannot contaminate its principal spectrum.
The off-diagonal scaling audit uses the actual initialize, recover, and production RHS path at nonzero scalar coupling and amplitude.

Matter stress sources in CCZ4 and metric-connection terms in matter are retained in the finite-wavenumber cross blocks; only their measured high-frequency limit is set to zero in the composed principal matrix.
Physical causality and coordinate gauge speed are reported separately.
seed_rationale: The campaign uses a deterministic nonzero-coupling state and exact Fourier modes; no random sampling is used.
